items.label: 最高纲领派
items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE complete transparent historical strategy-game adviser faction icon: a deliberately DESIGNED TYPOGRAPHIC EMBLEM made from exactly four uppercase Cyrillic letters С С Р М (ССРМ). The attached image is ONLY a reference for luminous GOLD palette and restrained painted metal rendering, NOT for its typesetting or composition. CRITICAL: visual design must come from DIFFERENT LETTER SIZES, OBLIQUE LETTERFORMS, STAGGERED BASELINES, overlapping and tightly fitted negative spaces, NOT fancy font curls or ordinary evenly spaced text. Use an asymmetric compact ascending-diagonal composition: a dominant large first С anchors the left; a clearly separate second С is smaller and raised; a tall Р rises near the middle-right, and a strong angular М locks into its lower-right. All four letters share a purposeful 12-degree forward slant and are nested into a unified dynamic nearly-square silhouette. Preserve left-to-right reading order С-С-Р-М while allowing vertical offsets. Some serifs and cross strokes may meet, but all four letter shapes and their openings must remain identifiable. Broad confident wedge-like serifs and clean Russian early-twentieth-century poster/letterpress forms; no thin filigree, no decorative swirls. This should look like a custom revolutionary-era printer's monogram, not a word typed in a fancy font. High overall brightness, pale ivory-gold broad faces, shallow amber engraved cuts, subtle satin painted metal, very little deep extrusion. Designed to read as a unique symbol at 20x20 pixels on a dark UI. Letters alone, no badge frame, backing, book, flag, tool, star, crown, underline or extra letters. SQUARE canvas with the complete artwork filling 84 percent of width/height and an 8 percent transparent margin. Genuine transparent background. Return one finished complete icon.

items.label: 孟什维克
items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign this entire gold Russian adviser faction monogram from scratch. EXACT abbreviation: FIVE uppercase Cyrillic letters Р С Д Р П (РСДРП), each letter appearing once in that order, including the TWO Р. The old image is only a palette/material reference; REJECT its ordinary two-row grid composition. This must become a bold, inventive CUSTOM LETTERING INSIGNIA whose artistry comes from SIZE CONTRAST, ROTATION, RHYTHM and ASYMMETRIC SPATIAL INTERLOCK, not curlicues or an ornate font. Build a compact three-level diagonal arrangement: a VERY LARGE tall Р anchors the left, leaning forward about 12 degrees; a much smaller С is raised into its upper-right negative space; a broad monumental Д sits low across the middle as an oblique structural base; a smaller second Р rises at middle-right; the final strong П nestles lower-right, rotated a little in counterpoint. Make sizes noticeably unequal, baselines staggered, with energetic forward motion and a stepped silhouette, not two flat rows and not five equal letters. Selected stems/serifs may overlap and share weight, but preserve the five recognizable Cyrillic forms, open counters and the Д's feet. Restrained wedge-shaped Russian letterpress serifs, early-twentieth-century revolutionary poster geometry, no calligraphic curls. Broad bright GOLD painted-metal faces, shallow amber bevels, minimal extrusion, high overall luminance matching reference. Think of a single designed emblem readable by silhouette at TINY 20x20 pixels, not a sentence. No backing, enclosing frame, banner, gear, book, pen, star, crown, underline or extra letters. Square canvas, complete artwork fully visible within 8 percent transparent margins. Genuinely transparent background. Return one complete finished transparent icon.

items.label: 社民盟
items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign this plain row of three Cyrillic letters into an ELEGANT ARTISTIC INTERLOCKING MONOGRAM for a historical Russian political adviser text icon. Exact abbreviation: С Д С (СДС), no other characters. A prominent tall central Д forms the structural spine; two stylized С letters sweep outward from it on either side in a carefully balanced composition, with interwoven terminals and selected shared horizontal strokes. Make this a single custom-drawn insignia, not three separate typeset letters. Strong old Russian newspaper masthead and engraved letterpress inspiration, flowing yet architectural, distinctive thick curved serifs and beautifully shaped negative spaces. Avoid fragile hairlines and fussy ornament so it still reads as a symbol at only 20x20 pixels. Keep the Cyrillic Д recognizable with its two bottom feet and open counter, and both С open and visible. Gold letters alone create the full emblem; no round/rectangular backing, frame, flag, handshake, pen, star, crown or extra objects. Luminous bright yellow GOLD with broad pale gold faces, shallow amber engraved shadows and subtle painted-metal historical-game finish, not cute, not a glossy 3D logo. SQUARE compact composition occupying 84 percent of width and height, transparent margins. Genuine transparent background. Return ONE complete finished icon.

reference_notes.menshevik: Cyrillic РСДРП with oversized first Р and Д, smaller С and second Р and final П; staggered asymmetric layout. Artistic identity mark, not historical official emblem.

reference_notes.sr_maximalist: Cyrillic ССРМ abbreviation for the historical Union of Socialist-Revolutionary Maximalists. New artistic monogram, not a historical official emblem. Large first С, smaller raised second С, tilted Р/М.
